'''Mistress al'Donel''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Activities ==
She complains to [[Bran al'Vere]] about the absence of storks at Bel Tine.{{ref/book|1|1}} In the illusion created by the [[oval ring]] during [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s testing, Mistress al'Donel is one of the people who plead with Nynaeve to help them.{{ref/book|13|20}}
